values.meaning: Reduced Cooldown (Pounce's cooldown after a takedown or Hunt bonus)

mechanics.claim: Pounce's cooldown starts counting down as soon as it is cast, not on landing.
Killing an enemy while in Cougar Form or using Pounce's Hunt bonus reduces Pounce's current cooldown to a minimum value, letting it be used again sooner.
mechanics.quote: Killing an enemy while in ''Cougar Form'' or using ''Pounce's Hunt'' bonus reduces ''Pounce's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} to a minimum value.

mechanics.claim: Takedown and Aspect of the Cougar can be cast during the Pounce dash, so the dash does not block the next cast.
mechanics.quote: ''{{ai|Takedown|Nidalee}} and {{ai|Aspect of the Cougar|Nidalee}} can be cast during the dash.''

mechanics.claim: The Bushwhack trap becomes stealthed only after a 1.5 second arming period, and springs on contact with an enemy to begin its damage-over-time.
mechanics.quote: lays a trap at the target location that becomes {{tip|stealthed trap|stealthed}} after arming over {{fd|1.5}} seconds

mechanics.claim: Bushwhack's damage is persistent, indirect damage and applies spell effects (e.g. on-hit-like triggers that key off spell effects).
mechanics.quote: ''Bushwhack'' deals {{tip|persistent damage}}, additionally tagged as {{tip|indirect damage}}, and applies {{tip|spell effects}}.

mechanics.claim: Traps have only 6 maximum health and can be destroyed by basic attacks, so they are not durable, persistent damage sources in a fight.
mechanics.quote: Traps have {{as|{{sti|health|6 '''maximum''' health}}}} and can only be damaged by champion [[basic attacks]]
